content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

When it comes to alternatives to Stripe, each platform has its pros and cons. PayPal, for example, offers a broad range of payment options but comes with a 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction fee. Gumroad, on the other hand, provides a simple way to sell digital products but restricts creators in certain countries. Lemon Squeezy offers a more flexible pricing model but is not available in many countries. NOWPayments, a sovereign alternative, provides automatic crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer account required. Each option requires a different level of infrastructure investment, from simple setup to complex configuration.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe's limitations in Nigeria and other countries are well-documented, but other platforms also restrict access in various regions. PayPal, for instance, has suspended accounts in Nigeria and Ghana, leaving creators without access to their funds for up to 180 days. Gumroad restricts creators in certain countries, forcing them to look for alternative solutions. Lemon Squeezy is not available in many countries, making it difficult for creators to find a reliable alternative. NOWPayments, on the other hand, operates in multiple cryptocurrencies, including BSC, Solana, and TRON, with low fees and no platform restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, each platform has its own set of rules. PayPal's fee structure is complex, with varying fees depending on the country and payment method. Gumroad's fees are more straightforward but come with limitations. NOWPayments offers automatic crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, making it a cost-effective option for creators.
